events.title: Tupac Shakur Remembered
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac's music and message continue to resonate. A true hip-hop icon.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Would Have Been 84
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, and would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: The world lost a true guitar god on this day. Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 today and still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and proving that 'Brass in Pocket' is always in style.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Celebrating the 54th birthday of the one and only Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to Liam Gallagher – still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971 in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years of 'Imagine'. John Lennon's message of peace and unity remains as relevant and powerful as ever.

events.title: The First iPod Was Released 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The original iPod turns 25 today – a quarter-century of music in your pocket.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the life and legacy of John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of John Lennon. Still inspiring us all.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliantly funny John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true national treasure.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Delight
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' still offers a sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Would Have Been 80
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we remember the incredible life and legacy of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Queen's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched, forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the musical landscape. A pivotal album that influenced so many.

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: Remembering the life and music of John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Always In Our Hearts
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message continue to inspire peace and love worldwide.
